tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Aubergine in dark, a pink-tinted paper in light. Never pure black or white.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped lists (Glass card, Section, Chip at rest, Input).

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, secondary buttons, icon buttons, neutral badges, progress tracks, the tab bar's active pill.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge on every glass surface.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The TOP border of a glass surface only, so it catches light. Pair with glass-border on the other three sides.

tokens.name: chrome-tint
tokens.usage: Tint laid over real blur on iOS chrome (tab bar, headers, sheets).

tokens.name: chrome-solid
tokens.usage: Chrome where blur is not used (Android, web): near-opaque instead.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, glass-fill and glass-fill-strong. 13.6:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, metadata, idle chip labels, on bg and glass surfaces. Dark 6.8:1 or better, light 5.1:1.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, section overlines, footnotes. FAILS 4.5:1 (dark 3.7:1, light 2.7:1): never for text a person must read to act. Suggested fix for light: raise to 0.56 alpha (4.5:1).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on an accent fill (primary button, accent icon button, checked checkbox). 9.0:1 dark, 5.7:1 light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Petal in dark, Berry in light. Primary actions, selection, links, active states; as text on bg and glass (dark 7.1:1+, light 5.1:1+).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: selected chips, accent badges, avatar wells, info alerts, empty-state wells. Light accent on it is 4.4:1, just under AA: keep that text 15px medium or larger.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Amber in dark, Honey in light. Glow, ratings, deposits and money. Light text 3.9:1 on bg: icons, numerals 19px+ and large text only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, paid, done. Always with a word or icon. Light text 3.7:1 on bg: FAILS for small text; suggested fix #187550 (5.0:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text (badge, inline alert). Light success on it is 3.3:1: see success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting, needs attention. Same value as gold by design. Light text 3.9:1: icons and large text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, declines. Dark 5.5:1+, light 4.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text, and the danger button's fill. Light danger on it is 4.3:1: keep that text 15px+.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows inside a Section, inset 16px from the left.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: silk-highlight
tokens.usage: Brand only. The brightest fold of the mark and the wordmark's top. Logo, splash and marketing; not for UI text.

tokens.name: silk-rose
tokens.usage: Brand only. The mark's body pink, softer and dustier than accent. Illustrations, social, packaging.

tokens.name: silk-mauve
tokens.usage: Brand only. The mark's shadowed side. Depth in brand graphics, never text.

tokens.name: silk-shadow
tokens.usage: Brand only. The deepest fold in the stem.

tokens.name: petal-smoke
tokens.usage: Brand only. The right petal's smoked rose.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Brand only. The light around the app icon and the reveal: accent's dark value, used at 10–45% opacity on bg dark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: a screen's hero title.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Prices, totals and counts. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: bodyStrong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; list row titles.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Chip labels, section actions, buttons md.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Save a look from the feed and choose this collection.
styles.usage: Supporting copy, alert messages, empty-state messages.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Deposits go straight to your stylist.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, tab labels (11px in the tab bar), timestamps.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section titles above glass groups. Always uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside or under the mark. Use the outlined wordmark files; this style is for live text only (splash, web hero).

spacing.note: A 4-point grid. The page gutter is 20.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges, gap between stacked label lines.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips (6), tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons, between a section title and its group.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Row gaps, inline alert padding, section header spacing.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding, list row side padding, input side padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: The page gutter (GUTTER), sheet side padding, button md side padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Button lg side padding, gaps between sections.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Large separations on long screens.

tokens.name: space-huge
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-giant
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding and splash.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target. Icon buttons smaller than this get hit slop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: List row icon wells, skeletons, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, inline alerts, photo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards and grouped sections.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets (top corners) and the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, search, segmented control, progress.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile: 230 on a 1024 square.

tokens.name: shadow-icon-glow
tokens.usage: Brand only: the light around the app icon on splash, store art and social. Not on UI cards (glass uses borders, not shadows).

duration.note: From src/shared/theme/motion.ts. Springs (settle, snap, sheet) are in the Motion section.

tokens.name: duration-press-in
tokens.usage: Press feedback starts. Ease out (0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).

tokens.name: duration-press-out
tokens.usage: Press releases.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: A state change: selected, checked.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Something moving across the screen. Ease in-out (0.77, 0, 0.175, 1).

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Something arriving.
